title: Grateful Dead Live at Dream Bowl on 1969-02-22

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1969 Dream Bowl show with a smoking Dark Star and excellent soundboard capture that’s clear for its era but a bit muffled in spots.
ai_review.review: This February 22, 1969 performance is praised for its blistering Jerry Garcia leads (especially on Dark Star, The Eleven and Lovelight), tight transitions from acoustic to electric, and a soaring first set.  The SBD source provides surprisingly clean audio for a ’69 tape – most listeners find it very listenable despite occasional muffling or minor distortion.

ai_rating.rationale: Out of ~38 reviews the average rating is ≈4.66; the vast majority are glowing about the music and only a few note modest sound‑quality issues, yielding a strong combined show + recording score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for a 1969 SBD; listeners describe it as “very good” and “cleaned‑up”, though a few note slight muffling, occasional distortion on Dark Star, and a missing patch on Death Don't.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Seamless acoustic‑to‑electric segue, strong first set that builds into a marathon Dark Star, followed by a high‑energy second set with tight transitions and extended improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly called “a man possessed”, praised for soaring leads, flawless tone, and driving the band into cosmic jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s percussion noted as precise and a key part of the high‑energy flow.
